The last rainfall samples we took had six hundred parts per million of&mdash;|Sidris Kolb and Cawa|<ref name="Balance Point" />}}
'''Cawa''' was a [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] research [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]]<ref name="Balance Point" /> who was an expert in [[Water/Legends|water]] purificiation.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|112|Cawa}}</ref> The scientist was assigned to [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo's]] [[Senate Select Committee for Refugees]] staff on [[Duro/Legends|Duro]]<ref name="Balance Point" /> in [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Along with [[Sidris Kolb]], Cawa was responsible for the surface water of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], an endeavor that encountered many setbacks and was made more complicated by [[Sidris Kolb]]'s cloud seeding efforts. During a meeting of the SELCORE research staff, the two engaged in an argument about their competing projects. Due to limited resources and projects that seemed to threaten each other, Cawa and the other researchers struggled to cooperate and such arguments were common.<ref name="Balance Point" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cawa first appeared in the [[2000]] novel ''[[The New Jedi Order: Balance Point]]'', written by [[Kathy Tyers]].<ref name="Balance Point" />
